license_required.quote: without having at the time of so doing a valid, unrevoked, and unsuspended certificate as provided for in this chapter, is guilty of a misdemeanor

issuing_authority.quote: The board shall issue a certificate to practice podiatric medicine to each applicant who meets the requirements of this chapter.

degree_required.value: Doctor of Podiatric Medicine (DPM) from an approved college or school of podiatric medicine, with a minimum 4-year curriculum of at least 4,000 hours
degree_required.quote: he or she has successfully completed a medical curriculum extending over a period of at least four academic years, or 32 months of actual instruction, in a college or school of podiatric medicine approved by the board. The total number of hours of all courses shall consist of a minimum of 4,000 hours.

accrediting_body.quote: Is approved by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education.

required.quote: before a certificate to practice podiatric medicine may be issued, each applicant shall show by evidence satisfactory to the board, submitted directly to the board by the sponsoring institution, that he or she has satisfactorily completed at least two years of postgraduate podiatric medical and podiatric surgical training in a general acute care hospital approved by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education.

duration.quote: satisfactorily completed at least two years of postgraduate podiatric medical and podiatric surgical training

kind.quote: "podiatric residency" means a program of supervised postgraduate clinical training, one year or more in duration, approved by the board.

exams.name: National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners (NBPME) Parts I, II, and III
exams.notes: Must be passed within the past 10 years
exams.quote: The applicant, within the past 10 years, has passed parts I, II, and III of the examination administered by the National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners of the United States

exams.name: Oral and practical examination
exams.notes: May be required by the board to ascertain clinical competence
exams.quote: The applicant has passed within the past 10 years any oral and practical examination that may be required of all applicants by the board to ascertain clinical competence.

interval_years.quote: Certificates to practice podiatric medicine shall expire at midnight on the last day of the birth month of the licensee during the second year of a two-year term.

required.quote: the board shall adopt and administer regulations requiring continuing education of those licensees.

available.quote: The board shall issue a certificate to practice podiatric medicine by credentialing if the applicant has submitted directly to the board from the credentialing organizations verification that they are licensed as a doctor of podiatric medicine in any other state

requirements.value: Must be licensed in another state, graduated from approved school, passed NBPME Part III or equivalent, completed CPME-approved postgraduate training, passed any required oral/practical exam, no disqualifying criminal acts or disciplinary actions, and received a disciplinary databank report from the Federation of Podiatric Medical Boards.
requirements.quote: The board shall issue a certificate to practice podiatric medicine by credentialing if the applicant has submitted directly to the board from the credentialing organizations verification that they are licensed as a doctor of podiatric medicine in any other state and meets all of the following requirements

regulatory_model.quote: without having at the time of so doing a valid, unrevoked, and unsuspended certificate as provided for in this chapter, is guilty of a misdemeanor.

title_protection.quote: Any person who uses in any sign or in any advertisement or otherwise, the word or words "doctor of podiatric medicine," "doctor of podiatry," "podiatric doctor," "podiatric surgeon," "D.P.M.," "podiatrist," "foot specialist," or any other term or terms or any letters indicating or implying that they are a doctor of podiatric medicine...without having at the time of so doing a valid, unrevoked, and unsuspended certificate...is guilty of a misdemeanor.

scope_protection.quote: Any person who uses in any sign or in any advertisement or otherwise, the word or words "doctor of podiatric medicine," "doctor of podiatry," "podiatric doctor," "podiatric surgeon," "D.P.M.," "podiatrist," "foot specialist," or any other term or terms or any letters indicating or implying that they are a doctor of podiatric medicine, or that they practice podiatric medicine, or hold themselves out as practicing podiatric medicine or foot correction as defined in Section 2472, without having at the time of so doing a valid, unrevoked, and unsuspended certificate as provided for in this chapter, is guilty of a misdemeanor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any cause set forth in Article 12 (commencing with Section 2220) may result in denial, suspension, revocation, or probationary conditions on a certificate.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may order the denial of an application for, or the suspension of, or the revocation of, or the imposition of probationary conditions upon, a certificate to practice podiatric medicine for any of the causes set forth in Article 12 (commencing with Section 2220)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing acts or crimes constituting grounds for denial of a certificate under Division 1.5.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant has committed no acts or crimes constituting grounds for denial of a certificate under Division 1.5 (commencing with Section 475).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action taken by any podiatric licensing authority against the applicant.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the board determines that no disciplinary action has been taken against the applicant by any podiatric licensing authority

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adverse judgments or settlements from the practice of podiatric medicine constituting a pattern of negligence or incompetence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant has not been the subject of adverse judgments or settlements resulting from the practice of podiatric medicine that the board determines constitutes evidence of a pattern of negligence or incompetence.

definition_quote.value: "podiatric medicine" means the diagnosis, medical, surgical, mechanical, manipulative, and electrical treatment of the human foot, including the ankle and tendons that insert into the foot and the nonsurgical treatment of the muscles and tendons of the leg governing the functions of the foot.
definition_quote.quote: "podiatric medicine" means the diagnosis, medical, surgical, mechanical, manipulative, and electrical treatment of the human foot, including the ankle and tendons that insert into the foot and the nonsurgical treatment of the muscles and tendons of the leg governing the functions of the foot.

methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosis, medical, surgical, mechanical, manipulative, and electrical treatment of the human foot

drug_authority.value: Local anesthesia only; other anesthetics must be administered by another licensed health care practitioner authorized to do so.
drug_authority.quote: A doctor of podiatric medicine shall not administer an anesthetic other than local. If an anesthetic other than local is required for any procedure, the anesthetic shall be administered by another licensed health care practitioner who is authorized to administer the required anesthetic within the scope of their practice.

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: the diagnosis, medical, surgical, mechanical, manipulative, and electrical treatment of the human foot, including the ankle and tendons that insert into the foot and the nonsurgical treatment of the muscles and tendons of the leg governing the functions of the foot.

amputation_authorized.quote: Perform a partial amputation of the foot no further proximal than the Chopart's joint.

anesthesia_authority.quote: A doctor of podiatric medicine shall not administer an anesthetic other than local.

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: Perform surgical treatment of the ankle and tendons at the level of the ankle pursuant to subdivision (e).

ankle_surgery_residency_requirement.quote: the doctor of podiatric medicine has surgical privileges, including the privilege to perform surgery on the ankle, in a general acute care hospital described in paragraph (1)

ankle_surgery_facility_requirement.quote: A doctor of podiatric medicine may perform surgical treatment of the ankle and tendons at the level of the ankle only in the following locations: (1) A licensed general acute care hospital...An ambulatory surgical center that is certified to participate in the Medicare Program

systemic_disease_local_manifestations_in.quote: a doctor of podiatric medicine with training or experience in wound care may treat ulcers resulting from local and systemic etiologies on the leg no further proximal than the tibial tubercle.

wound_debridement_authorized.quote: a doctor of podiatric medicine with training or experience in wound care may treat ulcers resulting from local and systemic etiologies on the leg no further proximal than the tibial tubercle.

vaccination_authority.quote: A doctor of podiatric medicine may independently prescribe and administer influenza and COVID-19 vaccines, consistent with recommendations adopted pursuant to Section 120164 of the Health and Safety Code, to persons three years of age or older.

hospital_privileges_nondiscrimination.quote: It is the policy of this state that a doctor of podiatric medicine shall be classified or treated as a doctor of podiatric medicine and shall not be classified or treated as an ancillary provider or other allied health professional in any health care setting or insurance reimbursement structure for any purpose.

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: Nothing in this chapter prohibits the manufacture, the recommendation, or the sale of either corrective shoes or appliances for the human feet.

assistant_surgeon_role_authorized.quote: Perform services under the direct supervision of a physician and surgeon, as an assistant at surgery, in surgical procedures that are otherwise beyond the scope of practice of a doctor of podiatric medicine.
